description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named HintLocales, which provides multiple EditText widgets with different hint locales set via EditorInfo#hintLocales. It is designed to test the behavior of input method editors (IMEs) with various locale hints.

classes.name: HintLocales
classes.description: An Android activity that creates multiple EditText views with different IME hint locale configurations for testing purposes.

methods.name: createEditTextWithImeHintLocales
methods.description: Creates an EditText with its IME hint locales set to the provided LocaleList, and sets a hint text indicating the locale configuration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, creates a vertical LinearLayout, and adds multiple EditTexts with different hint locale configurations for testing.
